blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. O God, come to my assistance.//\R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be...
Behold a great priest, who in his days//pleased God and was found righteous.
_Ps. 109_//The Lord said to my Lord:
Sit at my right hand,

blocks.text:
1. Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
  2. Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
  3. Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
  4. Jurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
  5. Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
  6. Judicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
  7. De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
  2. The Lord will send forth from Sion the sceptre of your power: rule in the midst of your enemies.
  3. With you is princely rule on the day of your strength, amid the splendours of the saints: from the womb, before the morning star, I begot you.
  4. The Lord has sworn, and he will not repent: You are a priest for ever according to the order of Melchizedek.
  5. The Lord at your right hand has crushed kings in the day of his wrath.
  6. He will judge among the nations; he will fill ruins: he will shatter heads in many lands.
  7. He will drink from the torrent on the way: therefore he will lift up his head.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Behold a great priest, who in his days//pleased God and was found righteous.
No one was found like him,//who kept the law of the Most High.
_Ps. 110_  I will give thanks to you,//O Lord, with my whole heart: in the council of the just and in the assembly.

blocks.text:
1. Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
  2. Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, † miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
  4. Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
  5. Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
  6. Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: † confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
  7. Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
  8. Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
  9. Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  10. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  11. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.
  2. His work is praise and majesty: * and his justice endures for ever and ever.
  3. He has made a remembrance of his wondrous works, † merciful and compassionate is the Lord: * he has given food to those who fear him.
  4. He will be mindful of his covenant for ever: * he will declare to his people the power of his works:
  5. That he may give them the inheritance of the nations: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.
  6. All his commandments are faithful: † confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.
  7. He has sent redemption to his people: * he has commanded his covenant for ever.
  8. Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
  9. A good understanding have all those who do it: * his praise endures for ever.
  10. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: No one was found like him,//who kept the law of the Most High.
Therefore the Lord made him grow//by an oath among his people.
_Ps. 111_  Blessed is the man who fears the Lord: who greatly delights//in his commandments.

blocks.text:
1. Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
  2. Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
  3. Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
  4. Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, † dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
  5. In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
  6. Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, † confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
  7. Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: † iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
  8. Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, † déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. His offspring shall be mighty upon the earth: * the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
  2. Glory and riches shall be in his house: * and his righteousness endures for ever and ever.
  3. A light has risen in the darkness for the upright: * he is merciful, compassionate, and just.
  4. Happy is the man who shows mercy and lends; † he shall order his affairs with judgment: * for he shall never be moved.
  5. The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear evil tidings.
  6. His heart is ready to trust in the Lord; † his heart is steadfast: * he shall not be moved until he looks down upon his enemies.
  7. He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; † his righteousness endures for ever and ever; * his horn shall be exalted in glory.
  8. The sinner shall see it and be angry; † he shall gnash his teeth and waste away: * the desire of sinners shall perish.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Therefore the Lord made him grow//by an oath among his people.
Priests of God, bless the Lord;//servants of the Lord,//sing a hymn to God, alleluia.
_Ps. 112_  Praise the Lord, O children://praise the name of the Lord.

blocks.text:
1. Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
  2. A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
  3. Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
  4. Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
  5. Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
  6. Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
  7. Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
  8. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  9. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. Let the name of the Lord be blessed, * from this time forth and for evermore.
  2. From the rising of the sun to its setting, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.
  3. The Lord is high above all nations, * and his glory above the heavens.
  4. Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells on high * and looks down upon the lowly in heaven and on earth?
  5. He raises up the needy from the earth, * and lifts the poor from the dungheap,
  6. To place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.
  7. He makes the barren woman dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.
  8. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Priests of God, bless the Lord;//servants of the Lord,//sing a hymn to God, alleluia.
Good and faithful servant,//enter into the joy of your Lord.
_Ps. 131_  Remember, O Lord, David,//and all his meekness:

blocks.text:
1. Sicut iurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Jacob:
  2. Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:
  3. Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:
  4. Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Jacob.
  5. Ecce audívimus eam in Ephrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
  6. Introíbimus in tabernáculum eius: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes eius.
  7. Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
  8. Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.
  9. Propter David, servum tuum: * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.
  10. Jurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * de fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
  11. Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum: * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos.
  12. Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum: * sedébunt super sedem tuam.
  13. Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
  14. Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo, quóniam elégi eam.
  15. Víduam eius benedícens benedícam: * páuperes eius saturábo pánibus.
  16. Sacerdótes eius índuam salutári: * et sancti eius exsultatióne exsultábunt.
  17. Illuc prodúcam cornu David: * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.
  18. Inimícos eius índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
  19. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  20. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. How he swore to the Lord, * and vowed to the God of Jacob:
  2. “I will not enter into the dwelling of my house, * nor go up into the bed of my resting place;
  3. I will not give sleep to my eyes, * nor slumber to my eyelids,
  4. nor rest to my temples, * until I find a place for the Lord, a dwelling for the God of Jacob.”
  5. Behold, we heard of it in Ephrata: * we found it in the fields of the wood.
  6. We will enter into his dwelling: * we will worship in the place where his feet stood.
  7. Arise, O Lord, into your resting place, * you and the ark of your sanctification.
  8. May your priests be clothed with justice: * and may your saints rejoice.
  9. For the sake of David your servant, * do not turn away the face of your anointed.
  10. The Lord swore truth to David, and he will not fail him: * “Of the fruit of your womb I will set upon your throne.”
  11. If your sons keep my covenant: * and these my testimonies, which I will teach them,
  12. their sons also forever * shall sit upon your throne.
  13. For the Lord has chosen Zion: * he has chosen it for his dwelling:
  14. “This is my rest forever and ever: * here I will dwell, for I have chosen it.
  15. Blessing I will bless her widow: * her poor I will satisfy with bread.
  16. Her priests I will clothe with salvation: * and her saints shall rejoice with rejoicing.
  17. There I will make the horn of David flourish: * I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.
  18. His enemies I will clothe with confusion: * but upon him shall my holiness flourish.”
  19. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation: Good and faithful servant,//enter into the joy of your Lord.

This Confessor of the Lord, whom the faithful venerate and whom the peoples throughout the world devoutly praise,
on this day has joyfully merited to ascend to the blessed heavenly thrones.
Who, devout, prudent, humble, and pure, led a life of sobriety without stain,
until the breath of life animated his human limbs.
By whose outstanding merit, frequently those sick members lying everywhere,
with the strength of disease overcome, are restored to health.
Therefore from here our choir, in his honour, sings fitting praise and celebrated triumphs,
that we may be helped through all ages by his holy prayers.
May salvation, honour, and power be his, who, shining upon the throne of heaven,
governs the order of the whole world, Three and One. Amen.

\V. The Lord led the righteous man//through straight paths.
\R. And showed him//the kingdom of God.

My soul magnifies the Lord.
And my spirit has rejoiced//in God my Saviour.

My soul magnifies the Lord.
And my spirit has rejoiced//in God my Saviour.

blocks.text:
1. Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
  2. Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
  3. Et misericórdia eius a progénie in progénies * timéntibus eum.
  4. Fecit poténtiam in bráchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
  5. Depósuit poténtes de sede, * et exaltávit húmiles.
  6. Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
  7. Suscépit Israël púerum suum, * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
  8. Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros, * Abraham et sémini eius in sǽcula.
  9. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
  10. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
blocks.translation:
1. For he has regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
  2. For he that is mighty has done great things to me; * and holy is his name.
  3. And his mercy is from generation unto generations * to those who fear him.
  4. He has shown strength with his arm; * he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
  5. He has put down the mighty from their seat, * and has exalted the humble.
  6. He has filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he has sent away empty.
  7. He has helped his servant Israel, * being mindful of his mercy.
  8. As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.
  9. Glory be...

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit. \V. Let us pray.
Grant, we beseech you, almighty God,//that the venerable solemnity
of blessed Birinus,//your Confessor and Bishop,
may increase in us both//devotion and salvation.
Through Our Lord Jesus Christ...

\R. Amen.
\V. The Lord be with you.//\R. And with your spirit.

\V. Let us bless the Lord.
\R. Thanks be to God.

blocks.text: The officiant continues in a low voice:

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God,//rest in peace.
\R. Amen.

blocks.chantTranslation:
I devoutly adore you, hidden God,//Truly hidden beneath these forms:
My whole heart yields to you,//For pondering you, it fails.
Sight, touch, and taste are fooled here,
But hearing alone believes://I believe all God's Son said;
Nothing is truer than Truth's word.//On the Cross God lay hidden,
Here both God and Man hide://Yet believing and confessing both,
I ask what the penitent thief asked.//
I do not see the wounds, like Thomas;//Yet I confess you as my God:
Make me trust you ever more,//Hope in you, and love you.
O memorial of the Lord's death!//Living Bread giving life to all!
Grant my soul to live from you,//And find you ever sweet.
Loving Pelican, Lord Jesus!//Cleanse me with your Blood:
One drop can make whole//The world from every sin.
Jesus, whom now I see veiled,//I pray for what I thirst for:
Seeing your unveiled face,//May I rejoice in your glory.
Amen.

blocks.text: A short period of silence follows.

blocks.chantTranslation:
\V. You have given them bread from heaven.
\R. Containing in itself all sweetness.

blocks.text:
\V. Orémus.
Deus qui nobis sub Sacraménto mirábili. passiónis tuæ memóriam reliquísti; tribue, quǽsumus, ita mos Córporis et Sánguinis tui sacra mystéria venerári, ut redemptiónis tuæ fructum in nobis iúgiter sentiámus. Qui vivis et regnas...
blocks.translation:
\V. Let us pray,
O God, who in this wonderful Sacrament left us a memorial of Your passion; we ask that we may honour the sacred mysteries of Your Body and Blood, so that we may feel continually within us the fruit of Your redemption. You who live and reign...

blocks.chantTranslation: for ever and ever. \R. Amen.

blocks.text: The priest blesses everyone and replaces the Blessed Sacrament in the tabernacle.

Benedíctus Deus.
Benedíctum Nomen Sanctum eius.
Benedíctus Jesus Christus, verus Deus et verus homo.
Benedíctum Nomen Jesu.
Benedíctum Cor eius sacratíssimum.
Benedíctus Sanguis eius pretiosíssimus.
Benedíctus Jesus in sanctíssimo altáris Sacraménto.
Benedíctus Sanctus Spíritus, Paráclitus.
Benedícta excélsa Mater Dei, María sanctíssima.
Benedícta sancta eius et immaculáta Concéptio.
Benedícta eius gloriósa Assúmptio.
Benedíctum nomen Maríæ, Vírginis et Matris.
Benedíctus sanctus Joseph, eius castíssimus Sponsus.
Benedíctus Deus in Ángelis suis, et in Sanctis suis.
blocks.translation:
Blessed be God.
Blessed be His Holy Name.
Blessed be Jesus Christ, true God and true man.
Blessed be the name of Jesus.
Blessed be His Most Sacred Heart.
Blessed be His Most Precious Blood.
Blessed be Jesus in the Most Holy Sacrament of the Altar.
Blessed be the Holy Spirit, the paraclete.
Blessed be the great Mother of God, Mary most holy.
Blessed be her holy and Immaculate Conception.
Blessed be her glorious Assumption.
Blessed be the name of Mary, Virgin and Mother.
Blessed be Saint Joseph, her most chaste spouse.
Blessed be God in His angels and in His Saints.

We praise you, Lord almighty,
Who sit above//Cherubim and Seraphim,//Whom angels, archangels bless,
And prophets and apostles praise.
We praise you, Lord, in prayer,//Who came to free us from sin:
We pray to you, great Redeemer,//Whom the Father sent
as shepherd of the sheep.//You are Christ,
the Lord and Saviour,//Born of the Virgin Mary.
